newsitem.title: NORWAY: Hydro reports disappointing drilling test.
newsitem.headline: Hydro reports disappointing drilling test.

text.p: Norsk Hydro ASA's results from its northern North Sea appraisal well 35/4-1 in license block 194 were disappointing, the Norwegian Oil Directorate said on Wednesday..

"Hydrocarbons were detected in several intervals but the well was not production-tested," a statement said. "The result is seen as disappointing, but the considerable collection of data has provided new and valuable information on this part of the North Sea."
The well, drilled to a depth of 4,905 metres below sea level, has now been permanently plugged and abandoned.
Partners in license 194 are Norsk Hydro with 25 percent, Saga Petroleum ASA with 10 percent, Elf Petroleum Norge AS with 10 percent and Statoil, or Den norske stats oljeselskap AS, with 55 percent.
